systems.system: Criminal record (Certificado do Registo Criminal) service of the civil and criminal identification offices
systems.country_label: Certificado do Registo Criminal; Identificação Civil e Criminal
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos
systems.tiers: Requested and issued on the spot at the civil and criminal identification offices and posts (May 2019); the record is fed by criminal bulletins from court sentences. No statement that it is digital

note: A justice ministry staff bulletin of May 2019: the identity-card print centre, how to get a criminal record certificate, an anti-corruption campaign. The police appear only as an enforcing party and a seminar guest; nothing on station records.
